subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: For corrupted Telegram/session state, should OpenClaw expose diagnosis only, an explicit backed-up reset/doctor repair, or automatic startup quarantine?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but recovery can discard or replace persisted session state, so automation should not choose the product safety boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Explicit backed-up repair
options.body: Status/doctor reports the corrupt or oversized session artifact and offers a user-confirmed backed-up reset or repair command.

options.title: Diagnostic-only first
options.body: Status/doctor surfaces file health and manual guidance without moving or recreating state yet.

options.title: Automatic quarantine
options.body: Startup moves aside bad state and recreates it automatically, accepting more recovery power and more risk to persisted continuity.

recommendation.title: Explicit backed-up repair
recommendation.body: Status/doctor reports the corrupt or oversized session artifact and offers a user-confirmed backed-up reset or repair command.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Telegram plugin status UX and session-state recovery boundaries, and this is the strongest history signal for that surface.
